mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_slo_policy WHERE enabled = 1 AND next_evaluation_at_ms <= #{nowMs} AND (evaluation_lease_owner IS NULL OR evaluation_lease_until_ms < #{nowMs}) ORDER BY next_evaluation_at_ms, id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_slo_policy SET next_evaluation_at_ms = #{nextEvaluationAtMs}, evaluation_lease_owner = NULL, evaluation_lease_until_ms = 0, evaluation_failures = 0, last_evaluated_at = #{evaluatedAt}, last_evaluation_status = #{status}, last_evaluation_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND evaluation_lease_owner = #{owner}
UPDATE ai_slo_policy SET next_evaluation_at_ms = LEAST(next_evaluation_at_ms, #{nowMs}) WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND enabled = 1
